categories.description: One or more category feeds to scrape (required for browseCategory mode). Availability depends on Region: US supports topstories, us, world, politics, science, weather, entertainment, lifestyle, health, sports, finance; UK supports topstories, uk, world, politics, science, weather, finance, sports; Canada supports topstories, canada, world, politics, us, science, weather, sports, finance; Australia supports topstories, australia, world, politics, science, sports, weather, finance; Singapore supports topstories, singapore, world, politics, sports, finance, weather; Japan supports topstories, domestic, world, business, entertainment, sports, it, science, local. Categories not available for the chosen region are skipped with a warning.
categories.title: Categories

includeArticleDetails.description: Open each article page to fill exact publication date, author, publisher URL, keywords, image dimensions, and the full summary. Turn off for the fastest, list-only records (dates may be approximate in search mode).
includeArticleDetails.title: Fetch Full Article Details

keyword.description: Optional: only return articles whose title or summary contains this keyword (case-insensitive).
keyword.title: Keyword Filter

maxItems.description: Maximum total articles to return across all queries or categories (1–1000). Pagination stops at this number or when the source is exhausted.
maxItems.title: Max Items

mode.description: What to collect: trending top stories, one or more category feeds, or a keyword search across Yahoo News.
mode.title: Mode

region.description: Yahoo News edition used for trending and category feeds. Search mode queries all of Yahoo News; this value labels the run.
region.title: Region

searchQueries.description: One or more keywords or phrases to search across Yahoo News (required for search mode). Results are paginated and deduplicated. E.g. 'AI regulation', 'climate change', 'Apple iPhone'.
searchQueries.title: Search Queries

sourceFilter.description: Optional: only return articles from publishers whose name contains this string (case-insensitive). E.g. 'Reuters', 'AP', 'BBC'.
sourceFilter.title: Source Filter
